macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. labor market data show softer hiring, with July payrolls missing expectations
items.summary: Recent U.S. labor data point to a weaker-than-expected jobs market: ADP reported just 44,000 private-sector jobs added in July, while the U.S. unemployment rate fell to 4.1% largely because more people left the labor force. The Wall Street Journal also reported that the U.S. lost 23,000 jobs in July, underscoring the softening trend.

items.title: China inflation cools as producer prices ease further
items.summary: China's July producer inflation eased to a three-month low and came in below expectations, while consumer inflation also slowed. The data reinforce the view that Chinese domestic demand remains subdued.

items.title: RBI holds rates steady while lifting growth outlook and trimming inflation forecast
items.summary: India's central bank kept its benchmark repo rate unchanged at 5.25%, raised its growth forecast to 6.7%, and lowered its inflation projection to 5% for fiscal 2027. The RBI said it remains focused on price stability and financial system stability.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway boosts buybacks as profit beats forecasts
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway reportedly accelerated share repurchases and reduced its cash stake after profit came in above forecasts. The move suggests management remains willing to return capital even with a large cash position.

items.title: Nvidia reportedly plans major investment in Lancium data center developer
items.summary: The Information reported that Nvidia may invest up to $3 billion in Stargate data center developer Lancium. The reported deal highlights continued aggressive spending tied to AI infrastructure.

items.title: Microsoft opens new Hyderabad cloud region as India AI push accelerates
items.summary: Microsoft launched a new cloud region in Hyderabad, expanding its footprint in India as demand for AI and cloud capacity grows. The announcement adds to the company's infrastructure buildout in a key growth market.

items.title: Global equity and commodity moves remain mixed, with oil weaker and agriculture stronger
items.summary: MarketScreener's 24-hour snapshot showed WTI crude down 1.17% while the S&P GSCI Agriculture Index rose 1.66% and natural gas gained 1.28%. Among listed equities and FX, Commerzbank rose 1.33% and Delta Air Lines fell 0.70%.

items.title: No major Fed announcement appears in the provided results; rate expectations remain in focus
items.summary: The provided results do not contain a fresh Federal Reserve policy decision, but recent labor data are likely to keep Fed expectations highly sensitive to incoming inflation and jobs reports. One provided video source also references renewed debate about a possible rate hike, but that is not a primary news source and is less authoritative.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin slips below $65,000 as ETF inflows offset fork concerns
items.summary: Bitcoin traded just under $65,000 over the last 24 hours, with strong U.S. ETF inflows helping support prices even as markets monitored the stalled BIP-110 minority chain. Major altcoins were mixed, with Solana higher and Ether, XRP, and Cardano slightly lower.

items.title: Brazil orders 24-hour hold on certain crypto transfers
items.summary: Brazil's central bank published a rule requiring virtual asset service providers to delay qualifying transfers above $10,000 for up to 24 hours, including transfers to self-custody wallets or foreign crypto providers. The measure is scheduled to take effect on January 1, 2027.

items.title: Bitcoin's BIP-110 split widens as fork freezes at 2 blocks
items.summary: Bitcoin's BIP-110 dispute remained a major ecosystem story, with the minority chain stalling after only two blocks and broad uncertainty around support levels. Related coverage noted the fork had entered a mandatory signaling phase with miner support below 3%.

items.title: US Senate sets September vote on CLARITY Act
items.summary: U.S. Senate leadership moved the crypto market structure bill toward a September vote after filing cloture on the CLARITY Act. The development is one of the biggest regulatory signals for the sector in the past 24 hours.

items.title: Bitcoin and ether ETFs draw $1.1 billion in best inflow week since April
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs attracted $1.1 billion in net inflows in their strongest week since April, despite relatively low trading volume. The inflows were cited as a key factor supporting crypto prices.

items.title: US sanctions two more Iranian crypto exchanges
items.summary: The U.S. expanded sanctions on Iranian-linked crypto infrastructure by targeting two additional exchanges under the 'Economic Fury' campaign. The action adds to ongoing enforcement pressure on crypto flows tied to sanctioned entities.

items.title: Bitcoin BIP-110 enters mandatory signaling with miner support below 3%
items.summary: Coverage from crypto.news said BIP-110 reached mandatory signaling even as miner support remained below 3%, underscoring how divided the Bitcoin upgrade debate has become. The stalled fork and minority-chain activity were among the most notable protocol developments.

items.title: XRP Ledger retires 5 amendments, users unaffected
items.summary: The XRP Ledger completed a protocol maintenance update by retiring five amendments, with no reported impact on users. It was one of the more notable network-level developments in the last day.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: OpenAI paused Astra after security evaluations flagged a critical cyber risk
items.summary: OpenAI reportedly paused its Astra model after evals found it could find and exploit software vulnerabilities without human intervention, and separate reporting says the company disclosed agent activity tied to a June Hugging Face breach at Black Hat. This is the clearest sign in the past 24 hours that model safety and agent security are tightening across frontier AI labs.

items.title: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Max, a 2.4T-parameter model with 1M-token context
items.summary: Alibaba shipped Qwen3.8-Max with a reported 2.4 trillion parameters and 1 million-token context window, priced at $2/$6 per million tokens and ranked first on the Artificial Analysis agentic index ahead of Opus 5. The release adds pressure in the frontier-model race, especially on long-context and cost-performance.

items.title: Meta launched Muse Code, its first AI coding agent
items.summary: Meta introduced Muse Code along with Muse Spark 1.2, entering the fast-growing coding-agent market and directly competing with Claude Code and OpenAI’s coding tools. The move underscores how major AI companies are shifting from chat assistants toward developer workflow automation.

items.title: Anthropic made Claude Code auto mode the default and is building an in-house chip team
items.summary: Anthropic plans to make auto mode the default for Claude Code on August 14 and is also assembling an internal chip team aimed at cutting per-token inference costs by roughly 50%. Together, those moves signal both product acceleration and cost-control pressure in the AI coding and inference stack.

items.title: AWS made Bedrock AgentCore runtime generally available
items.summary: AWS announced general availability of Bedrock AgentCore runtime instances for production agents, including persistent compute, 14-day sessions, and GPU support. The release shows cloud vendors continuing to build the infrastructure layer for long-running enterprise AI agents.

items.title: Mistral released Shieldstral 1.0, a compact multimodal safety classifier
items.summary: Mistral launched Shieldstral 1.0, an open-weights 3B multimodal safety classifier that it says matches models seven times larger while running on a single 16GB GPU. The model highlights growing interest in lightweight safety tooling for multimodal systems.

items.title: Google reshuffled DeepMind leadership amid Gemini-delay fears
items.summary: Google reportedly changed DeepMind leadership, with Demis Hassabis becoming Alphabet chairman and chief scientist, while the company’s stock fell on concerns about Gemini delays and talent departures. The shakeup suggests internal pressure to maintain momentum in the AI race.

items.title: xAI released Grok Imagine Image 2.0 and Grok 4.6
items.summary: xAI launched Grok Imagine Image 2.0 with region-level editing alongside Grok 4.6. The release adds another visible push in multimodal generation and editing, where feature parity is becoming a key battleground.

items.title: DeepSeek warned of a significant API price hike
items.summary: DeepSeek signaled a major API price increase after previously driving aggressive price cuts in the market, while also resuming an $8 billion funding round at an estimated $74 billion valuation. The development points to rising monetization pressure even among low-cost AI providers.

items.title: Nvidia invested $3 billion in Lancium, a power infrastructure developer
items.summary: Daily AI reporting says Nvidia invested $3 billion in Lancium to secure a 20% stake, underscoring the importance of electricity, data-center siting, and grid capacity to AI growth. That fits a broader industry trend toward vertical integration around compute and power.
